mapper.select: SELECT contract_id, product_id, product_version, host_type, connector_type, entry_surface, package_id, expert_entry_id, registration_status, candidate_enabled, public_route_enabled, authoritative_credit_enabled FROM fbs_attribution_product_contract WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND product_version = #{productVersion} FOR UPDATE

SELECT challenge_id, contract_id, server_binding_id, nonce_hash, tenant_subject_digest, issued_at, expires_at, retention_until, status FROM fbs_host_forwarding_challenge WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND server_binding_id = #{serverBindingId} AND contract_id = #{contractId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_host_forwarding_challenge (challenge_id, contract_id, server_binding_id, nonce_hash, tenant_subject_digest, issued_at, expires_at, retention_until, status) VALUES (#{challengeId}, #{contractId}, #{serverBindingId}, #{nonceHash}, #{tenantSubjectDigest}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{retentionUntil}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE fbs_host_forwarding_challenge SET status = #{status} WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND status = 'ISSUED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_attribution_evidence_event (event_id, receipt_id, challenge_id, contract_id, server_binding_id, tenant_subject_digest, stage, outcome, entry_surface, channel_track, observed_at, sequence_no, sample_count, canonical_digest, signer_key_id, issuer, audience, receipt_nonce_hash, receipt_signature, issued_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{receiptId}, #{challengeId}, #{contractId}, #{serverBindingId}, #{tenantSubjectDigest}, #{stage}, #{outcome}, #{entrySurface}, #{channelTrack}, #{observedAt}, #{sequenceNo}, #{sampleCount}, #{canonicalDigest}, #{signerKeyId}, #{issuer}, #{audience}, #{receiptNonceHash}, #{receiptSignature}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_id = VALUES(event_id)
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, receipt_id, challenge_id, contract_id, server_binding_id, tenant_subject_digest, stage, outcome, entry_surface, channel_track, observed_at, sequence_no, sample_count, canonical_digest, signer_key_id, issuer, audience, receipt_nonce_hash, receipt_signature, issued_at, expires_at, event_watermark FROM fbs_attribution_evidence_event WHERE receipt_id = #{receiptId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_attribution_snapshot (snapshot_id, contract_id, window_start, window_end, retention_until, watermark_at, event_high_watermark, row_count, parse_error_count, gap_count, invalid_count, canonicalization_version, event_digest, runtime_release, embedded_release, signer_key_id, issuer, audience, snapshot_signature, status) VALUES (#{snapshotId}, #{contractId}, #{windowStart}, #{windowEnd}, #{retentionUntil}, #{watermarkAt}, #{eventHighWatermark}, #{rowCount}, #{parseErrorCount}, #{gapCount}, #{invalidCount}, #{canonicalizationVersion}, #{eventDigest}, #{runtimeRelease}, #{embeddedRelease}, #{signerKeyId}, #{issuer}, #{audience}, #{snapshotSignature}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot_id, contract_id, window_start, window_end, retention_until, watermark_at, event_high_watermark, row_count, parse_error_count, gap_count, invalid_count, canonicalization_version, event_digest, runtime_release, embedded_release, signer_key_id, issuer, audience, snapshot_signature, status FROM fbs_attribution_snapshot WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND window_start = #{windowStart} AND window_end = #{windowEnd} FOR UPDATE
